title: POCTech CGMS and xdrip+
body:
Hello evrebody.
My name is Dmitry Tretyakov.
I have type 1 diabetes since 1980 year and live in Ukraine.
Now I am testing a new Chinese system of continuous glucose monitoring (CGMS) POCTech.

I have the documentation on the data exchange protocol with the transmitter poktech.

I am very sorry that xdrip+ does not support data input from the POCTech transmitter.
Сould you help me and modify the program xdrip+ to work with the POCTech transmitter?

Yours sincere admirer Dmitry Tretyakov.

comments.body:
Hello!
We can try to tighten it.
transcontrol37@gmail.com
Sergey

Hello Sergey.
I am very grateful to you for the answer.
Zhejiang POCTech Co., Ltd.  promised to give me the documentation on the
communication prootocol with her transmitter on 16.07.2019.
I hope they keep their promise.
As soon as the protocol documentation is in my hands, I will contact you.
I will be very grateful for your help.
Sincerely, Dmitry Tretyakov.
